battle.name: 征服加拉馬
battle.brief: 公元202年，羅馬皇帝塞維魯斯在安息戰線纏鬥之際，派海軍沿紅海南下，遠征南阿拉伯的薩拜與哈德拉毛諸國，攻克內陸城邑、迫其接受宗主權，羅馬的香料航線自此短暫受控。卡面的羅馬標槍正是這支遠征軍的核心投射兵器：以密集齊射壓制城牆上的守軍，槍幹中空、矛頭折斷，使敵難以回收。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的兩方是羅馬帝國與南阿拉伯的薩拜—哈德拉毛聯盟。羅馬方面由皇帝塞維魯斯（193至211年在位）直接發動，執行單位是敘利亞行省總督轄下的遠征軍，骨幹是一個野戰軍團的步兵大隊，混編各行省的輔助步騎兵與弓兵，並由埃及貝雷尼科斯及紅海沿岸基地調來的海岸分遣隊與海軍船隊支援。羅馬在阿拉伯半島從無常設軍團，阿拉伯行省（佩特拉）主要靠輔助軍與若干小隊守備，所以這次遠征是一場由敘利亞抽調、靠船運完成的長距離攻勢。薩拜方面是今日也門南部以馬里卜（Marib）為中心、以示巴人諸部落為主體的王國，聯合同樣以哈德拉毛為勢力範圍的城邦與遊牧部落；其武裝以部落自徵的步兵、弓箭手、投石手與騎兵組成，另有若干受希臘化城市傳統影響的城防民兵。薩拜與哈德拉毛之間的關係並不牢固，兩方長期爭奪內陸高原的商路控制權，這種聯盟內部的裂痕也是羅馬能各個擊破的重要原因。整場衝突沒有正式宣戰，也沒有留下條約記錄，羅馬的行動在編年史中是以「羅馬人來了，取了希馬里特人的地方」的形式出現的。
countriesEn: Two sides fought this war: the Roman Empire and the Sabaean–Hadramawt alliance of southern Arabia. On the Roman side the campaign was launched directly by Emperor Septimius Severus (reigned 193–211), and the instrument of it was an expeditionary force drawn from the command of the governor of Syria. Its backbone was the infantry of one field army, mixed with auxiliary infantry and cavalry from the provinces, with archers, and with a coastal detachment and its shipping summoned from the bases at Berenice in Egypt and along the Red Sea. Rome kept no legion permanently in Arabia: the province of Arabia Petraea was garrisoned mainly by auxiliaries and small detachments, which is why this was a long-range offensive carried out by sea from Syria. On the other side stood the Sabaean kingdom centred on Marib in today's southern Yemen, built on the Sabaean tribes and joined by the city-states and pastoral communities of the Hadramawt. Its armed force consisted of tribal levies of spearmen, archers, slingers and cavalry, together with civic militias in the Hellenised towns. Saba and the Hadramawt were not solid allies: they competed for control of the caravan roads across the southern plateau, and that fracture inside the alliance is part of the reason Rome could defeat them piecemeal. There was no formal declaration of war and no surviving treaty; in the chronicles the Roman action appears simply as the statement that the Romans came and took the land of the Himyarites.
people: 皇帝塞維魯斯是這場遠征的政治推手。公元202年他正在安息（帕提亞）戰線親自指揮羅馬大軍，無法遠赴阿拉伯，命令只能交由敘利亞方面的行省將軍與海軍當局執行。史料沒有留下統一可靠的指揮官姓名：部分研究把這次遠征同敘利亞總督治下的高級將軍聯繫起來，但各種抄本與後世編年史的寫法互有出入，很難斷定。薩拜方面可確認的是國王與諸部族首領的地位：薩拜王室的世系有銘文可考，有銘文的最後一位薩拜王是沙馬爾·尤哈里什（Shammar Yuhar'ish），而202年前後的阿拉伯與希臘化編年史又提到希拉茲（Hiraz）之名；兩者是否同一人、是否即被羅馬降服的那位國王，學界並無定論。真正在戰場上起作用的是一批中層人物：羅馬的執旗手、百夫長與輔助軍百夫長，決定齊射的節奏與標槍的射界；薩拜與哈德拉毛的部落首領，決定是死守城牆還是退入內陸山區。商人與船工同樣關鍵，他們熟悉季風航線與暗礁，知道哪一段海路在一年中的哪一季可以通行，遠征軍的糧水能否接得上，往往取決於這些人的判斷。
peopleEn: Severus himself was the political author of the expedition. In 202 he was personally conducting the Roman main effort against the Parthians and could not go to Arabia, so the orders had to pass to a provincial commander under the governor of Syria and to the naval authorities. The sources preserve no single reliable name for the commander in chief: some scholarship links the expedition with the senior legate in Syria, but the manuscript traditions and the later chronicles spell the name differently, and the point cannot be settled. On the Sabaean side what can be confirmed is the standing of the king and the tribal chiefs. The Sabaean royal line is known from inscriptions, the last Sabaean king with an inscription in his own name being Shammar Yuhar'ish, while the Arabic and Hellenistic chronicles around 202 mention a Hiraz; whether the two are one man, and whether either is the king who came to terms with Rome, remains disputed. What really mattered on the battlefield were the middle ranks: on the Roman side the signifers, centurions and auxiliary centurions, who set the rhythm of the volleys and the range of the javelins; on the Sabaean and Hadramawt side the tribal leaders, who decided whether to hold the walls or to fall back into the mountains inland. Merchants and sailors were equally important, for they knew the monsoon routes and the shoals and which stretch of sea could be run in which part of the year; whether the grain and water of the expedition could be kept in contact often depended on their judgement.
kits: 卡面的羅馬標槍（pilum）是這場遠征中最具代表性的兵器：中空鋼管連同鉛或硬質金屬矛頭約半米長，安裝在木柄前端，整支標槍長約兩公尺，重量約一公斤。它的設計重點是讓矛頭在命中盾牌或鎧甲後折斷或彎曲，使敵人既難拔出、又無法回收再投；卡面說的正是這個特性：捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。在南阿拉伯那種乾燥少雨、植被稀疏的開闊地帶，標槍幾乎不受地形遮蔽限制，羅馬步兵的密集齊射可以在數十步外連續覆蓋同一片區域，逼迫對方弓手縮在土壘與城垛之後。與標槍配套的還有：短劍（gladius）用於盾牆之間的近身搏鬥；大型橢圓凸面塔盾（scutum）構成正面防禦；輔助部隊的輕型方盾與小圓盾、希臘式複合弓及阿拉伯弓、輔助標槍；以及工兵的鏟、斧、鎬與繩梯。攻城方面羅馬有成熟技術：撞柱、雲梯與配重投石機（ballista），能把城牆上的守軍逐段清空。海軍方面使用紅海型貨船改裝的運輸船與小型登陸艇。薩拜與哈德拉毛方面則以木矛、複合弓、投石索與圓盾為主，並大量使用駱駝騎兵，這是內陸高原上羅馬騎兵難以正面對付的對手。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card is the most characteristic weapon of the expedition. Its hollow steel tube, capped with a lead or hardened metal head, is about half a metre long and is fixed to the front of a wooden shaft, so that the complete pilum is some two metres long and weighs about a kilogramme. The design point of the missile is that the head bends or breaks after striking a shield or a cuirass, so that a shield can hardly be cleared and the weapon cannot be recovered for a second throw; the card states exactly this property, that it snaps after running through a shield and the enemy can only drag the broken half back behind cover. In the dry, sparsely vegetated open country of southern Arabia the pilum was hardly restricted by cover, and the dense volleys of the Roman infantry could sweep the same stretch of ground again and again at ranges of several dozen paces, forcing the defenders' archers to crouch behind earth banks and crenellations. Working with it were the gladius, used in the close fighting behind the shield wall; the large convex oblong scutum that made up the front; the light square and small round shields, the Hellenistic composite bows and Arab bows, and the auxiliary javelins of the auxiliaries; and the engineer's spades, axes, picks and rope ladders. For siege work Rome had a mature technical repertoire — battering rams, scaling ladders and counterweight ballistae — capable of clearing the defenders from a wall section by section. On the sea the fleet used Red Sea freighters converted for transport together with small landing craft. The Sabaeans and the Hadramawt relied on wooden spears, composite bows, slings and round shields, and fielded large numbers of camel cavalry, a form of enemy the Roman horse found hard to handle on the southern plateau.
tactics: 羅馬的戰法是海路進軍、步兵決戰。遠征船隊沿紅海東岸南下，經阿拉伯行省的萊凱·科梅（Leuke Kome，今烏拉一帶）與穆扎（Muza，今荷台達一帶）等港站補給淡水與食糧，在也門海岸登陸，佔領港市與河口，然後以陸軍沿乳香道進入哈德拉毛內陸。作戰上，軍團以第一線密集盾陣前推，第二、三線的投槍手輪流齊射，箭矢與標槍交替覆蓋前方同一段地面；接近之後，羅馬的短劍兵在盾牌掩護下刺入金屬防禦薄弱的薩拜步兵陣線，把對手從城牆上撬下來；遇到居高臨下的射擊，就壓低盾陣、結成龜甲（testudo）通過無遮蔽地段。薩拜與哈德拉毛的軍隊多依託城牆、峽口與梯地防守，用弓矢與長矛消耗進攻方，騎兵則繞到側翼與背後，切斷糧道與海陸聯絡點。羅馬必須同時守住已登陸的海岸基地與向前伸出的補給線，這是遠征中最脆弱的一環；因此海軍分遣隊被留下來護航與守備港口，遠征軍在推進速度與鞏固據點之間反覆折衷。
tacticsEn: Rome's method was to advance by sea and decide the matter on foot. The expedition's ships ran south along the east side of the Red Sea, taking on water and provisions at the roadsteads of Leuke Kome (around Ula today) in the province of Arabia and at Muza (around al-Hudaydah), then landed on the Yemeni coast, seized the harbours and the river mouths, and sent the army inland along the incense road into the Hadramawt. In action the legion advanced with the first line locked in a dense shield wall, while the javelin-men of the second and third lines delivered volley after volley, arrows and pila alternating over the same beaten ground; on contact the gladiator infantry stabbed forward under cover of their shields to prise the Sabaean foot away from the wall, the Sabaean line having little metal defence; where fire came down from above, the Romans flattened their shields and closed into a testudo to cross the open stretch. The Sabaean and Hadramawt armies generally fought behind walls, defiles and terrace edges, spending arrows and spears on the attacker while their cavalry worked round the flanks and the rear to cut the food route and the link with the landing places. Rome had to hold the coast bases it had already taken and the supply line running forward at one and the same time, and that was the most fragile part of the expedition; naval detachments were therefore left behind to escort the convoys and garrison the ports, and the field army had to keep trading off the speed of its advance against the consolidation of the ground it had won.
data: 這場戰爭的數字記錄極為殘缺，必須分辨哪些出自古代記載、哪些屬現代推算。古代方面基本只有年份：敘利亞編年史（札卡里亞斯·瑞托爾所編）記「在希臘人紀年第五百一十三年，即公元201或202年，羅馬人來了，取了希馬里特人的地方」，這是判定202年這個年份的主要依據。戰役的具體日期、交戰次數與雙方死傷，古代文獻一概沒有留下數字，任何精確到人數的傷亡說法都屬後人杜撰。現代研究方面：羅馬自奧古斯都以來每年向阿拉伯附庸王國支付津貼，是帝國財政上的一筆大開支，塞維魯斯因安息戰爭財政吃緊而停付或削減，被普遍視為遠征的直接導火線。航程方面，從埃及貝雷尼科斯沿紅海到也門海岸約一千五百公里，內陸到薩拜首都馬里卜還要再走約兩百公里。物資上，羅馬每年進口的乳香以千噸計，學界有人估計達五千噸左右。標槍本身重約一公斤，有效射程一般不超過三十公尺，因此羅馬一次齊射可以覆蓋數十步寬的正面。遠征軍的具體兵力古代並無記載；合理的推測是混合部隊的規模，即一個軍團的野戰大隊加上若干輔助軍部隊與海軍分遣隊。
dataEn: The numerical record for this war is very thin, and it matters to separate what the ancients actually wrote down from what modern scholarship infers. On the ancient side there is essentially only the year: the Syriac Chronicle, compiled by Zacharias Rhetor, records that in the year 513 of the Greeks, that is AD 201 or 202, the Romans came and took the land of the Himyarites, and this is the principal basis for dating the affair to 202. The exact dates of the operations, the number of engagements and the losses on both sides are nowhere recorded, and any casualty figure given to the last man is a later invention. On the modern side: the subsidies that Rome had paid every year to the Arab client kings since the time of Augustus were a large item in the imperial budget, and the financial strain of Severus' Parthian war led him to stop or cut them, which is generally treated as the immediate trigger of the expedition. In distance terms, some fifteen hundred kilometres of Red Sea separate Berenice in Egypt from the Yemeni coast, and roughly another two hundred kilometres of inland road lead from the coast to the Sabaean capital of Marib. In tonnage, Rome's annual imports of frankincense ran into thousands of tonnes, and estimates as high as about five thousand tonnes a year have been proposed. A pilum itself weighs about a kilogramme and its effective range does not exceed thirty metres, so a single Roman volley can sweep a front of several dozen paces. The size of the expeditionary force is not recorded at all; the reasonable assumption is a combined arms column of the order of a legion's field detachment, some auxiliary units and a naval contingent.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是錢：乳香與沒藥是羅馬貴族最貴重的進口品，紅海航線的關稅與抽成是敘利亞與埃及行省的重要收入。羅馬自奧古斯都時代起遵循前朝慣例，每年向示巴與哈德拉毛的國王支付津貼，條件是他們保障通往印度洋的商路安全並看管帝國境內的商人；這種津貼制度本來是買平安，卻在半個世紀裡變成了負擔。塞維魯斯在安息戰線連年用兵、財政吃緊，選擇停付津貼，附庸國的態度隨即轉硬。第二層是權：控制紅海與阿拉伯的航線，等於在安息帝國的側翼插上一把刀，也可以在安息或其盟友干擾時，給羅馬一個戰略支點。第三層是商路本身：南阿拉伯各城邦彼此爭奪乳香產區與商隊護衛權，薩拜與哈德拉毛之間的衝突長期化，劫掠羅馬商船、扣押商人與傳教士的事時有發生，給了羅馬出兵的口實。必須強調，這不是一場為信仰或榮譽而發的戰爭，而是一場以財政與戰略計算為核心、兼有邊疆治理意味的有限戰爭。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause behind the fighting. The first was money. Frankincense and myrrh were the costliest imports of the Roman aristocracy, and the customs and dues collected on the Red Sea route were a substantial revenue for the provinces of Syria and Egypt. From the time of Augustus Rome had followed its predecessors' practice of paying an annual subsidy to the kings of Saba and of the Hadramawt, on condition that they kept the road to the Indian Ocean safe and policed the emperor's merchants. What had been bought as protection had over half a century become a burden. Severus, stretched by years of campaigning against the Parthians and squeezed for money, chose to stop the subsidies, and the attitude of the client kingdoms hardened at once. The second layer was power: control of the Red Sea and of the Arabian routes was a knife set against the flank of the Parthian empire, and a strategic pivot in case the Parthians or their allies ever tried to interfere. The third layer was the trade itself. The South Arabian city-states fought each other over the incense-producing lands and the escorting of caravans, and the friction between Saba and the Hadramawt was long-running; the raiding of Roman shipping, the seizure of merchants and of missionaries were recurrent, and these gave Rome its pretext to intervene. It must be stressed that this was not a war of faith or of honour but a limited war driven by fiscal and strategic calculation, with an added element of frontier policing.
impact: 短期看，羅馬在南阿拉伯取得的是一份隨時可以收手的戰果：哈德拉毛內陸的部分城邑與商路被置於海軍巡邏與使節監督之下，薩拜王國承認羅馬的宗主權，羅馬商人重新在紅海南段活動，襲擾商船的事減少。這種有宗主權而無行省的安排，正是羅馬在阿拉伯半島的典型做法。長期看，影響卻有限：塞維魯斯本人不久於211年病死安息戰線，羅馬在遠東的注意力隨之轉移；阿拉伯與哈德拉毛在3世紀重新取得獨立，薩拜諸城邦恢復舊有的商路控制與內部權力結構，270年代薩拜的殘餘勢力被希馬里特吞併，此後才是阿克蘇姆王國於525年攻下希馬里特，也門最後被納入衣索比亞體系。更長遠的影響在觀念與記憶：對後來的阿拉伯與也門史家而言，202年是羅馬人第一次深入阿拉伯半島並短暫佔領的年份，這段記憶被寫入後出的編年史與地理書；對羅馬自身，這次遠征證明海軍足以支撐跨越一千五百公里的攻勢，卻難以把佔地與治理連結起來。
impactEn: In the short term what Rome gained in southern Arabia was a result it could let go of again at will: several towns of the inner Hadramawt and the caravan roads were placed under naval patrol and the supervision of envoys; the Sabaean kingdom acknowledged Roman overlordship; Roman merchants moved again in the southern Red Sea; and the raiding of shipping declined. This arrangement of overlordship without a province was the standard Roman practice in Arabia. In the long term, however, the effect was limited. Severus himself died on the Parthian front in 211 and Rome's attention in the Far East shifted with him. Arabia and the Hadramawt regained their independence in the third century; the Sabaean cities recovered their old way of controlling the roads and their internal balance of power; in the 270s the last Sabaean power was absorbed by Himyar, and only then did the kingdom of Aksum take Himyar in 525, drawing Yemen at last into the Ethiopian sphere. The longer-term importance is one of idea and memory: for later Arab and Yemeni historians the year 202 is the year in which the Romans first pushed deep into Arabia and held it briefly, and this memory was written into the later chronicles and geographies; for Rome itself the expedition showed that a navy could sustain an offensive across fifteen hundred kilometres of sea, yet could not easily tie occupation to government.
result: 結果是薩拜—哈德拉毛聯盟屈服。羅馬遠征軍在阿拉伯海岸建立據點後循陸路向內陸推進，依靠密集的標槍齊射壓制密集排列的薩拜步兵，配合短劍兵與攻城器材逐次奪取城邑，最終迫使哈德拉毛內陸的諸城與薩拜王室接受羅馬的宗主安排；國王與部族首領被帶入羅馬的勢力範圍，或被派為使節赴敘利亞，馬里卜一帶的稅收與乳香道轉由羅馬指定的機構與本地代理一同管理。羅馬沒有在也門設行省，也沒有長期駐紮軍團，只留下分遣隊與駐紮在關鍵港市的小部隊，用以護航並保證商路暢通。因此這場戰爭以征服而非兼併收場：以一次成功的攻勢換來約半個世紀的商路順利，代價則是距離與補給線的脆弱，十年之內便暴露無遺。
resultEn: The outcome was the submission of the Sabaean–Hadramawt alliance. Having established its bases on the Arabian coast, the Roman expeditionary force pushed inland, using dense pilum volleys to pin down the closely packed Sabaean infantry, gladiators and siege works to take the towns one by one, until the towns of the inner Hadramawt and the Sabaean royal house accepted the Roman arrangement of overlordship. The king and the tribal chiefs were brought within the Roman sphere, or sent as embassies to Syria, and the revenues of the Marib area and of the incense road came to be administered by Roman appointees together with local agents. Rome founded no province in Yemen and stationed no legion there, leaving only detachments and small bodies at the key harbours to escort the shipping and keep the roads open. The war therefore ended in conquest rather than annexation: one successful offensive bought roughly half a century of orderly trade, at the price of distance and of a supply line that proved extremely fragile and was laid bare within a decade.
